create_quantized_relu6: create a quantized ReLU6 activation module with optional in-place operation
build_quantized_hardswish: build a quantized Hardswish activation using scale and zero_point parameters
test_quantized_leaky_relu: test the quantized LeakyReLU activation with configurable negative slope and in-place mode
refactor_quantized_prelu: refactor a float PReLU module to quantized PReLU with quantized weight and scale zero_point
convert_quantized_multihead_attention: convert an observed MultiheadAttention module to quantized form with quantized bias_k and bias_v
